profile.description: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash brings Gemini's multimodal reasoning to controllable video generation. Generate from text, images, or video, then extend scenes with coherent motion, or interpolate between start and end frames for smooth, deliberate camera movement. Natural-language editing and multimodal referencing keep your scene consistent as it grows.
